name: QuickChef golden dataset
description: Curated dish resolution, typeahead, recipe, cart, flow, photo and edge cases for QuickChef.

modes.offline: Deterministic; LLM disabled, no network. Safe for CI.
modes.live: Needs GROQ_API_KEY for dish/recipe/flow cases and network access for photo cases.

gates.offline: Every offline case must pass; mean score 1.0.
gates.live: Every live case must pass; run nightly or before a release.

notes: Matar Kulcha remains a live ambiguity case: the canonical dish stays Matar Kulcha and the card must offer Chole Kulche.
Typeahead cases are deterministic and verify AND semantics for paneer/chaap searches.
Baselines live in evals/baselines and are written with --write-baseline.
Catalogue suggestions remain deterministic; the custom path may use the LLM for new dishes.
Photos are shown only on the custom confirmation card and only when the relevance/quality gate passes.
